segments.text:
V. 18.
A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither a corrupt tree good fruit—But it is certain, the Goodneſs or Badneſs here mentioned, reſpects the Doctrine, rather than the perſonal Character: For a bad Man preaching the good Doctrine here delivered, is ſometimes an Inſtrument of converting Sinners to GOD. Yet I do not aver, That all are True Prophets, who ſpeak the Truth, and thereby convert Sinners. I only affirm, That none are ſuch who do not.
